rules.mean/1: the lowest train mean loss, ties by id (cycles 1-5)
rules.median/1: the lowest train median loss, ties by mean then id
rules.trimmed/1: the lowest 10%-trimmed train mean loss, ties by mean then id
rules.signtest/1: among configurations whose train mean beats the incumbent's by > 1%, the smallest one-sided sign-test p against the incumbent on train items, ties by mean then id; none -> mean/1
rules.netwins/1: among configurations whose train mean beats the incumbent's by > 1%, the most train wins minus losses against the incumbent, ties by mean then id; none -> mean/1
rules.stress-mean/1: among configurations that pass the train gain AND both train-derived stress sets (every answer verified), the lowest train mean; none -> mean/1
rules.stress-signtest/1: as signtest/1 among configurations that also pass both train-derived stress sets; none -> mean/1
